title: VAPETASIA KILLER FRUITS BLUE RAZZ TFN E-JUICE 100ML
description:
Check out Killer Fruits Blue Razz e-juice by Vapetasia Synthetic.
This is a new Blue Razz ejuice blend that has now been perfected, providing all the delicious and tart flavors you’ve been waiting for. By offering nothing less than smooth and flavorful vapes, this is certainly a vape you should be considering. It uses a beautifully crafted blend of blue raspberries.
Killer Fruits Blue Razz comes in a large 100 ml bottle and can be used with nicotine strengths of 0mg, 3 mg and 6 mg.
Vapetasia Killer Fruits Blue Razz TFN E-Juice 100ml Features
:
Bottle Size – 100mL Unicorn Bottle
Flavor Profile – Blue Raspberry
Available Nicotine – 0mg | 3mg | 6mg
VG/PG Ratio – 70VG/30PG
